about: Editions of the default legal texts (legal/*.md). Changing any of the four files is a new edition: copy the outgoing files to legal/editions/<old edition>/, add an entry on top (published = the day, app = the release it ships in, digest = what tests/legal.test.mjs prints), describe the change in the texts' change history (terms § 17 / privacy § 15), and update `covers`. docs/LEGAL.md 'Changing the texts'.

covers.about: What the current edition describes. A cookie the app sets, or a per-account storage area (src/lib/storage/quota.ts StorageArea), that is missing here fails tests/legal.test.mjs: describe it in the privacy notice first.

storageAreas.cv: privacy § 3 Content: CV profile, versions, job offers, applications
storageAreas.craft: privacy § 3 Content: files saved from the Craft apps
storageAreas.workflows: privacy § 3 Workflows, run history, credentials, webhook requests
storageAreas.jobs: privacy § 3 (server jobs: working files deleted when the job ends)
